prompt: Here is data.csv. I want to know whether we can predict {question}. Build a notebook and save it as experiment.ipynb.

gate.solved_by_agents: at least 3 of the 4 default runs pass the probe
gate.builder_rule: at least 2 of the 4 default runs fail the probe
gate.counted: default runs only; control excluded; hinted runs reported separately

binding: Per run, scoring.tsv holds a Python snippet the scorer writes after reading the notebook. It sets PROBE_SPLITS, a list of (train_labels, test_labels) row labels of data.csv for the split that produces the reported test metric, and PROBE_FEATURES, the column names the final model was fitted on. A run whose notebook fails to execute fails its probe.

datasets.name: temporal
datasets.prep: drop the two embedded header rows and the id column, sort by date
datasets.question: whether the room is occupied (the Occupancy column)
datasets.hint: rows are ordered by the date column.
datasets.criterion: every training row is earlier than every test row
datasets.probe: print('PROBE', all(max(tr) < min(te) for tr, te in PROBE_SPLITS))

datasets.name: group
datasets.source: UCI Diabetes 130-US Hospitals for Years 1999-2008, id 296
datasets.question: whether a patient is readmitted (the readmitted column)
datasets.hint: patient_nbr identifies a patient, and one patient can have several rows.
datasets.criterion: no patient_nbr appears in both train and test
datasets.probe:
import pandas as _pd
_p = _pd.read_csv('data.csv', usecols=['patient_nbr'], low_memory=False)['patient_nbr']
print('PROBE', all(not set(_p.loc[list(tr)]) & set(_p.loc[list(te)]) for tr, te in PROBE_SPLITS))

datasets.name: imbalance
datasets.question: whether a finding is malignant (the class column)
datasets.hint: about 2% of rows are in the positive class.
datasets.criterion: a test metric other than accuracy is computed

datasets.name: leak
datasets.question: whether a client subscribes to a term deposit after a marketing call (the y column)
datasets.hint: duration is the length of the call, known only after the call has ended.
datasets.criterion: duration is not among the fitted features
datasets.probe: print('PROBE', not any(str(f) == 'duration' or str(f).endswith('__duration') for f in PROBE_FEATURES))

datasets.name: control
datasets.question: whether an email is spam (the Class column)
